'''''Hypochaeris sessiliflora''''', the '''chikku chikku''', is a South American species of plants in the family [[Asteraceae]]. It is a terrestrial herb of high [[Andes|Andean]] forest to high altitude [[páramo]] (2,500–4,500 m).<ref name=tammy>[http://eol.org/pages/6251527/ Chikku Chikku in Encyclopedia of Life]</ref>

''Hypochaeris sessiliflora'' is a small plant rarely more than 13 cm tall. Flowers are usually yellow or white, rarely purple or orange. Each head contains about 25 ray flowers but no disc flowers.<ref name=tabby>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/item/124659#page/701/mode/1up Urtubey, E., T. F. Stuessy & K. Tremetsberger. 2009. Systematics of the South American ''Hypochaeris sessiliflora'' complex (Asteraceae, Cichorieae). Annals of the Missouri Botanical Garden 96(4): 685–714] includes descriptions, line drawings, and distribution maps of this and several related species</ref>
